## Purpose
Notes item for the remediation that follows the 2026-11-20 adversarial review of the scale-factor and TPC-DI session. It holds the owner's decisions, the work order and the gates that still stop at the owner. It is never implemented itself; it closes when every item below is done, dropped or blocked on a named owner gate.

## Delivery
Owner's choice: "one branch and one PR per feature, worked one at a time, in dependency order. No registered batch." Each feature has an umbrella item its members need.

## Work order
1. Record decisions; close the decision-only items.
2. Duration gate: close #4384, #4385, delete three branches, drop two items (duration-gate-redesign-prs-owner-decision-20261120).
3. TPC-DS error reporting (feature-fix-tpcds-scale-error-reporting-20261120).
4. Corpus classification, seed field, class snapshot check, superseded-generator label (feature-fix-corpus-classification-and-seed-provenance-20261120).
5. Heavy guard #4331 reduced to attribution and admission hold (heavy-guard-4331-review-repairs-20261120).
6. #4322 SF 1 measurements and probe, then stop for the budget (generator-volume-gate-sf1-measurement-probe-and-budget-20261120).
7. #4340 label, LakeSail 4g SF 1 run, legacy-overlay list, then stop.
8. TPC-DI: confirm AQ9 and VQ6 and prepare a draft fix; record the FactMarketHistory rationale; correct the page on site `next`.
9. Scheduled-refresh alert (fast-baseline-reproduce-as-review-evidence-and-refresh-cadence-20261120).
10. Read-only inventory and review of the 11 to 16 November work (session-work-20261111-16-inventory-and-review-20261120).
11. Correction comment on #4381, text shown first.
12. Design-only items that end at the owner: heavy-guard pause, mirror validator.
13. Cleanup of settled worktrees and scratch.
14. Monday 2026-11-23: test a scheduled refresh without re-authoring.

## Delivery (owner, 2026-11-22; this replaces the 2026-11-20 delivery choice above only in adding subagents)
"Three features in turn, each on its existing pull request with its member items built by subagents: #4331, then #4322, then #4340. Then small standalone pull requests. No registered batch." At most 2 subagents implement at once. Items created by other sessions are left out and not touched.

Order:
1. Records: correct stale item text; finish raw-run-evidence-deleted-and-4381-authorship-record-20261120 per its decision; append the #4410 calibration finding to fast-duration-gate-calibration-skew-20261028 and finish fast-duration-gate-runner-class-spread-20261120.
2. #4331: heavy-guard-4331-review-repairs-20261120.
3. #4322: generator-volume-gate-rename-bypass-20261120, ci-diagnostics-pr-remove-dead-pid-helper-and-false-credit-20261120, generator-volume-gate-ungated-schema-and-seed-inputs-20261120, generator-volume-gate-sf1-measurement-probe-and-budget-20261120; then close ci-fast-duration-gate-rerun-and-baseline-drift-20261113 narrowed to what #4322 delivers.
4. #4340, only after the TPC-DI session's develop seed recut has merged: doris-lakesail-corpus-notes-and-label-corrections-20261120, lakesail-docker-4g-default-sf1-evidence-20261120, ledger-legacy-overlay-moves-need-owner-approval-20261120.
5. Monday refresh test, whenever its pull request opens: fast-baseline-refresh-commit-identity-owner-setting-20261120.
6. Small standalone pull requests: interactive-prompt-omits-tpcds-official-points-20261120; tpc-legend-missing-for-tpch-tpcds-20261120; inert-path-guard-misses-computed-reader-paths-20261120; scale-floor-not-enforced-in-direct-class-construction-20261120.

8. Designs and inventory that end at the owner: mirror-validator-refuses-offlist-tpch-tpcds-bundles-20261120; heavy-guard-pause-design-20261120; results-no-validation-evidence-labelled-passed-other-benchmarks-20261120.
9. Last: remediation-worktree-and-scratch-cleanup-20261120.
Left blocked: ssb-and-primitives-sf100-generation-validation-20261120 (bigger host).

## Gates that still stop at the owner (2026-11-22)
- #4322: a measurement that differs from the gate's path by more than 5% without an explanation; a probe pull request that does not fail `core`.
- #4340: the LakeSail run failing at 4g; a seed recut that touches entries outside the approved set.
- A pull request refused twice at arming stops that feature; other work continues.
- The mirror-validator design, the heavy-guard pause design if written, and the no-validation inventory each end blocked for the owner's approval.
- Each item's own decisions are recorded on the item, in its context, dated 2026-11-22.
- Hold labels: #4322, #4331 and #4340 carry `no-auto-merge`, applied on the owner's instruction on 2026-11-20. The owner authorised lifting each when its item's gates are met, then arming once.
- Settled earlier and no longer open: the criteria question on ci-fast-duration-gate-rerun-and-baseline-drift-20261113 (narrowed; closes with #4322); the deleted run directories (decision on the item); the #4381 correction comment (posted; item done).

## Guardrails (accepted by the owner, 2026-11-20)
The agent never posts a stand-in review, resolves a review thread, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. It arms with `make pr-arm` once per pull request and reports the result. Subagents implement items under the delivery above (owner, 2026-11-22); they make no tracker write and open no pull request. A text the owner has chosen is used verbatim; any other new name or message follows existing conventions and is listed in the pull request (owner, 2026-11-22). A blocked step stops this item; the agent moves to the next item and does not work around the block.
